overall_goal: Add crumbled stock cubes to the mushroom broth and squeeze the liquid from the mushrooms

goals.description: Crumble and add the first stock cube to the mushroom broth
goals.rationale: The person opens a box of stock cubes, unwraps one, crushes it, and pours it into the broth, ensuring the wrapper is empty.

goals.description: Crumble and add a second stock cube to the mushroom broth
goals.rationale: The person takes another stock cube, crumbles it, and empties it completely into the broth.

goals.description: Squeeze the liquid out of the mushrooms using a fork
goals.rationale: The person uses a fork to press down on the mushrooms in a jug to extract their liquid.

goals.description: Stir the broth and move the saucepan off the hob
goals.rationale: The person stirs the stock into the broth, taps the fork to remove excess liquid, and then moves the saucepan away from the heat.
